name: CybaaAgent
description: The user-initiated half of Cybaa's two documented agents. Cybaa's bot policy says this one "performs user-initiated checks on behalf of Cybaa customers", validating "security headers, TLS/SSL configuration, and other domain-specific security controls", and "operates only when explicitly triggered by a customer request". The operator states its requests are "targeted and limited in scope" and that it "does not perform broad crawling" — the broad crawl is its sibling CybaaBot.
